routes.name: Full Crimp Milk
routes.desc: Leftmost line, short and bouldery. Shares anchors with 'Wadumori'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Wadumori
routes.desc: Shares anchors with 'Full Crimp Milk'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Society of Gravitational Studies
routes.desc: All titanium bolts.
routes.setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1993

routes.name: Mama Zu
routes.desc: The steep face right of 'Society of Gravitational Studies'. Stainless steel glue-in bolts.

routes.name: Arts & Sport
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Wake & Bake', then left onto the face. All titanium bolts.
routes.setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1993

routes.name: Wake & Bake
routes.desc: Climbs the obvious corner crack. Shares anchors with 'By Way of Deception'. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: By Way of Deception
routes.desc: Warning Flora and Fauna: Wasps/Hornets Starts right of the 'Wake & Bake' corner, shares the same anchor. Original start is hidden behind the shack. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Jugs for Jumping
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Jumping for Jugs', then left.
routes.setter: Ghop The Rockshop, Maxi Montree & Zak Zakariya, 2021

routes.name: Jumping for Jugs
routes.desc: As the name suggests, jump for the jug to start. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Nair Nawn
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Jumping for Jugs', then right to the anchor of 'Fips, der Affe'. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Fips, der Affe
routes.desc: Shares the first meters into the corner with 'The Day After', then left over the bulge to a technical balancy finish. Shares the anchor with 'Nair Nawn'. 2 titanium bolts, 4 slings.

routes.name: The Day After
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Fips, der Affe', then straight up, sharing anchors with 'No Onion, No Garlic'. 4 titanium bolts, 2 slings.

routes.name: No Onion, No Garlic
routes.desc: Warning Fixed Gear: Old slings Up the tufas, then left to a pumpy finish. Shares the last two clips and anchors with 'The Day After'. 4 titanium bolts, 4 slings.

routes.name: Aunt Mary Johanna & Two Girls
routes.desc: Closed Old bolts and slings, overgrown. Cannot be climbed anymore.
warnings: Closed Old bolts and slings, overgrown.

routes.name: No Name
routes.desc: Pumpy start through the overhang left of 'Schlingel Max'. Easier finish. 1 titanium bolt, 4 slings.

routes.name: Son Thoi
routes.desc: Share start with 'Schlingel Max', then turn left to anchor of 'No Name'.

routes.name: Schlingel Max
routes.desc: Interesting crux on polished rock. 5 titanium bolts, 1 sling.

routes.name: Don Quijote de la Mancha
routes.desc: Starts just left of 'Schlingel Moritz'. Technical start, easy middle section and a big move above the bulge. Don't cheat at the start by going too far right. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Schlingal Moritz
routes.desc: Warning Fixed Gear: The rope sheath at the top anchor was damaged Hard start for the grade, especially when you're short. All titanium bolts.
warnings: Fixed Gear: The rope sheath at the top anchor was damaged

routes.name: Good Medicine
routes.desc: One pockety tough crux towards the middle, then smooth sailing - top is a beautiful and much easier slab. All titanium bolts.
routes.setter: Björn Alber, Nantawan Alber & Robert Baier, 2006

routes.name: Reminiscence
routes.desc: A true Tonsai beach classic. Starts on the tufas right of 'Good Medicine'. 8 titanium, 1 expansion bolt.

routes.name: Maxi's Project
routes.desc: Squeezed in on the steep featureless rock between 'Reminiscence' and 'Mai Mee Fahn'.

routes.name: Mai Mee Fahn
routes.desc: Hard crux right at the start to get up to the tufas. Afterwards easier, but continuous. Reachy both at the start and towards the anchor. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Avocado Power
routes.desc: All titanium bolts.

routes.name: The Lion King
routes.desc: Climbs around the prominent flake with insanely polished feet. Though the crux awaits right before the anchor. All titanium bolts.
routes.setter: Volker Schöffl, Melanie Schöffl & Sam Lightner, 1996

routes.name: The Tiger Queen
routes.desc: Easy start towards a crimpy crux. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Thai Taam Nean
routes.desc: Project about 8b, though only bolted with expansion bolts.

routes.name: Storm in Head
routes.desc: Extension of 'Thai Tham Nean'. Also only expansion bolts.

routes.name: Jai Dum
routes.desc: An amazing line linking a series of small flakes up the beautiful orange wall. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Of Popes and Power
routes.desc: All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Greed
routes.desc: Currently the hardest ascent in Thailand. ‘It’s On’ from start to finish. Phenomenal climbing. All titanium bolts.

routes.name: Hot Springs
routes.desc: Broken hold, needs repairs and rebolting. Protected by expansion bolts.

routes.name: Asia Shadow Play
routes.desc: Starts up the stairs towards 'Tyrolean Wall'. Shares the first few meters with 'The Sit Spins', then straight up. All titanium bolts.
routes.setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1994

routes.name: The Sit Spins
routes.desc: Shares the start with 'Asia Shadow Play'. Traverses right, then up along the crack. Be careful, the crux just above the ledge is badly protected. All titanium bolts.
routes.setter: Sam Lightner, Gerd Schöffl & Volker Schöffl, 1995

routes.name: The Sit Spins (Direct Start)
routes.desc: Direct start to 'The Sit Spins'. Starts on 4 slings to cut off traversing, just on the very left of 'Tyrolean Wall'. Face climb on small holds with a big move to reach the ledge.

routes.name: The Sit Spins (Extension)
routes.desc: Extension of 'The Sit Spins' or 'Remix Direct'. Goes to the top of the wall. Great endurance climbing with an interesting finale. Titanium bolts. Anchors need new titanium circular ring and new rope.
